title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.35102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($\rho=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios,

translated_title: 有用的多样性还是幻觉的多样性？面向电商搜索的人格条件化合成查询生成
translated_abstract: 合成监督可以为新的搜索领域引导语义解析器的冷启动，但提示诱导的多样性只有在生成内容忠实于结构化意图时才有用。我们在冷启动电商搜索场景中对这一问题进行了探索：使用6个大语言模型配合9个人格条件化提示词家族，在47字段的英国汽车模式上生成了118,098个合成查询对，并与1,214条人工标注查询和15,304条生产查询进行对比。我们表明，IPIP人格捆绑包在所有四组匹配对比中都提升了语义解析器的F1（经Holm校正的p<.001），并且在完整的2³网格上，所有三个捆绑包都具有正向主效应。语法条件化是将生成结果推向真实流量分布的关键维度，同时也能诱导词汇多样性。对齐sKL——即分别拟合到合成查询与人工标注查询上的von Mises-Fisher分布之间的散度——是解析器F1的一种无标注代理指标（与为模拟购物者场景编写的人工查询相比，ρ=-0.917……
tldr: 该研究通过人格条件化提示生成大规模合成查询来冷启动电商语义解析器，发现IPIP人格捆绑包可显著提升解析器F1、语法条件化能引导生成结果更贴近真实流量，并提出对齐sKL作为解析器性能的无标注代理指标。
en_tdlr: This study shows that persona-conditioned synthetic query generation effectively bootstraps e-commerce semantic parsers—IPIP personality bundles significantly improve parser F1, syntax conditioning steers generations toward real traffic—and proposes alignment sKL as a label-free proxy for parser performance.
